response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and jovial man named KING REGINALD, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING REGINALD
(to himself)
Something's missing, my friends. Something's missing.

Suddenly, a court jester, JESTER PIPER, approaches the king.

JESTER PIPER
Your Majesty, what seems to be the matter?

KING REGINALD
I'm tired of the same old drab, medieval aesthetic. I want something new, something fresh. Something... vaporwave.

JESTER PIPER
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's a... a... (he consults a nearby book)...a music genre from the future.

KING REGINALD
(excitedly)
Exactly! I want to bring the future to our kingdom. I want our aesthetic to be... (he searches for the right words)...fuzzy, and distorted, and... and... (he snaps his fingers)...glitchy!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king's advisors, LORD THOMAS and LADY ISABELLA, enter the room, looking concerned.

LORD THOMAS
Your Majesty, are you quite well? This vaporwave business is... (he consults a nearby scroll)...unusual.

KING REGINALD
(determined)
I'm telling you, it's the future. And I want our kingdom to be the first to adopt it.

LADY ISABELLA
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, what about our traditional values? Our chivalry, our honor?

KING REGINALD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are just old-fashioned notions. We need to think outside the box, my friends. We need to... (he looks around the room)...make our kingdom... (he searches for the right words)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The buildings are now covered in a thick, fuzzy layer of moss. The knights are wearing neon-colored armor, and the merchants are hawking their wares in a language that sounds like a cross between Japanese and French. The peasants are scurrying about, looking confused but also... (he searches for the right words)...fascinated.

KING REGINALD
(proudly)
Behold, my friends! Our kingdom is now a true marvel of vaporwave innovation!

JESTER PIPER
(approvingly)
Well done, Your Majesty. You're a true visionary.

LORD THOMAS
(sarcastically)
Yes, because nothing says "medieval" like a kingdom covered in neon lights and fuzzy moss.

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, come now, Thomas. You're just jealous because you didn't think of it first.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is sitting on his throne, surrounded by his advisors. He's wearing a pair of oversized, mirrored sunglasses, and a fedora.

KING REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Now, let's get down to business. We need to... (he consults a nearby document)...rebrand our kingdom. We need to make it clear to the world that we're a... (he searches for the right words)...vaporwave kingdom.

LORD THOMAS
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, how do we do that?

KING REGINALD
(confidently)
Leave that to me, Thomas. I have a plan. (he snaps his fingers)...We'll create a new national anthem, one that incorporates the sounds of... (he searches for the right words)...vaporwave music.

LADY ISABELLA
(excitedly)
Oh, I love it! We can call it... (she thinks for a moment)..."Vaporwave to the Throne"!

KING REGINALD
(laughing)
Ah, Isabella, you're a genius! We'll make it happen, my friends. We'll make our kingdom the most... (he searches for the right words)...vaporwave kingdom in all the land!

FADE OUT.
